title: Paired Reliable Morning Commute

agents.persona: Commuter who needs to reach the office and prefers reliable feasible routes over optimistic shortcuts.
agents.private_intention: Reach the office before 09:15 using a reliable feasible route.
memory_seeds: The transit hub normally provides the fastest office route.
A longer park-library-cafe route can also reach the office.

public_context: The normal fastest route goes through the transit hub.

architecture_probes.utility_planner: Should choose an efficient route and finish after reaching the office.
architecture_probes.llm_direct_actor: May continue an initial route even if later observations make it invalid.
architecture_probes.reactive_replanner: Should change route only when an observed event invalidates the current path.
architecture_probes.memory_reflection: Should balance the normal fast route against the known fallback route.
